source.query:
SELECT
    if(timestamp >= toStartOfDay(now()) - INTERVAL 7 DAY, 'current_complete_7d', 'prior_complete_7d') AS period,
    properties.homepage_layout_version AS homepage_layout_version,
    if(toInt(properties.viewport_width) < 768, 'mobile', 'desktop') AS viewport,
    toInt(properties.homepage_section_position) AS section_position,
    properties.homepage_section_title AS section_title,
    toInt(properties.content_item_position) AS item_position,
    properties.content_title AS item_title,
    properties.destination_url AS destination_url,
    uniqIf(properties.homepage_visit_id, event = 'homepage_item_viewed') AS viewers,
    uniqIf(properties.homepage_visit_id, event = 'homepage_section_click') AS clickers,
    countIf(event = 'homepage_section_click') AS clicks,
    round(100 * uniqIf(properties.homepage_visit_id, event = 'homepage_section_click') / greatest(uniqIf(properties.homepage_visit_id, event = 'homepage_item_viewed'), 1), 1) AS viewer_ctr
FROM events
WHERE timestamp >= toStartOfDay(now()) - INTERVAL 14 DAY
    AND timestamp < toStartOfDay(now())
    AND event IN ('homepage_item_viewed', 'homepage_section_click')
    AND properties.homepage_visit_id != ''
GROUP BY period, homepage_layout_version, viewport, section_position, section_title, item_position, item_title, destination_url
HAVING viewers > 0 OR clickers > 0
ORDER BY period DESC, section_position, item_position, viewers DESC

SELECT

  item_position, item_title, destination_url,
  uniqIf(person_id, viewed > 0) AS viewers,
  uniqIf(person_id, viewed > 0 AND clicked > 0) AS clickers,
  sum(clicked) AS clicks,
  uniqIf(visit_id, viewed > 0) AS viewing_visits,
  uniqIf(visit_id, clicked > 0 AND viewed = 0) AS click_visits_without_exposure,
  round(100.0 * clickers / nullIf(viewers, 0), 1) AS viewer_ctr
FROM (
  SELECT
    if(timestamp >= toStartOfDay(now()) - INTERVAL 7 DAY, 'current_complete_7d', 'prior_complete_7d') AS period,
    person_id, properties.homepage_visit_id AS visit_id,
    properties.homepage_layout_version AS homepage_layout_version,
    if(toInt(properties.viewport_width) < 768, 'mobile', 'desktop') AS viewport,
    toInt(properties.homepage_section_position) AS section_position,
    properties.homepage_section_title AS section_title,
    toInt(properties.content_item_position) AS item_position,
    properties.content_title AS item_title,
    properties.destination_url AS destination_url,
    countIf(event = 'homepage_item_viewed') AS viewed,
    countIf(event = 'homepage_section_click') AS clicked
  FROM events
  WHERE timestamp >= toStartOfDay(now()) - INTERVAL 14 DAY
    AND timestamp < toStartOfDay(now())
    AND event IN ('homepage_item_viewed', 'homepage_section_click')
    AND properties.homepage_visit_id != ''
    AND NOT coalesce($virt_is_bot, false)
  GROUP BY period, person_id, visit_id, homepage_layout_version, viewport,
    section_position, section_title, item_position, item_title, destination_url
)
GROUP BY period, homepage_layout_version, viewport, section_position, section_title,

ORDER BY period, section_position, item_position, viewers DESC

SELECT
  period, homepage_layout_version, device_type,
  uniq(person_id) AS unique_viewers, count() AS visits,
  round(avg(sections_viewed), 1) AS average_sections_viewed,
  round(median(deepest_position), 1) AS median_deepest_position,
  round(avg(max_scroll), 1) AS average_max_scroll,
  uniqIf(person_id, deepest_position >= 1) AS reached_hero,
  uniqIf(person_id, deepest_position >= 2) AS reached_articles,
  uniqIf(person_id, deepest_position >= 3) AS reached_training,
  uniqIf(person_id, deepest_position >= 4) AS reached_videos,
  uniqIf(person_id, deepest_position >= 5) AS reached_newsletter
FROM (
  SELECT
    if(timestamp >= toStartOfDay(now()) - INTERVAL 7 DAY, 'current_complete_7d', 'prior_complete_7d') AS period,
    person_id, properties.homepage_visit_id AS visit_id,
    properties.homepage_layout_version AS homepage_layout_version,
    any(properties.$device_type) AS device_type,
    max(toFloatOrZero(properties.homepage_sections_viewed)) AS sections_viewed,
    max(toFloatOrZero(properties.homepage_deepest_section_position)) AS deepest_position,
    max(toFloatOrZero(properties.maximum_scroll_percent)) AS max_scroll
  FROM events
  WHERE timestamp >= toStartOfDay(now()) - INTERVAL 14 DAY
    AND timestamp < toStartOfDay(now())
    AND event = 'homepage_sections_summary'
    AND properties.homepage_visit_id != ''
    AND NOT coalesce($virt_is_bot, false)
  GROUP BY period, person_id, visit_id, homepage_layout_version
)
GROUP BY period, homepage_layout_version, device_type
ORDER BY period, homepage_layout_version, device_type
